record.paper_title: TWISTED GGP PROBLEMS AND CONJECTURES, GGP IV
record.original_question: Assume E/F = C/R. Let Π be an irreducible generic principal series representation of GL_n(C) induced from characters χ_j(z) = |z|^{r_j}(z/̅z)^{k_j/2} with k_j integers, and let μ(z) = (̅z/z)^α for a half-integer α that is not an integer. Prove that Hom_{U(V_{p,q})}(Π, ω_{V_{p,q},ψ,μ}) is nonzero exactly for the signature (p,q) satisfying #{j : k_j > α} = p and #{j : k_j < α} = q = n - p.

evidence.quote: Conjecture 6.1. Assume that E/F = C/R. Let Π = Ind^{GL_n(C)}_{B(C)}(χ_1⊗···⊗χ_n) be an irreducible generic principal series representation ... Then for ψ(x)=e^{2πix}, Hom_{U(V_{p,q})}(Π,ω_{V_{p,q},ψ,μ}) ≠ 0 if and only if #{j:k_j>α}=p and #{j:k_j<α}=q=n−p.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $E/F = \mathbb{C}/\mathbb{R}$. For an integer $n \geq 1$ and integers $p,q \geq 0$ with $p+q = n$, let $V_{p,q}$ denote the $n$-dimensional skew-Hermitian space over $\mathbb{C}$ of signature $(p,q)$, and let $U(V_{p,q})$ be its unitary group.

Fix the additive character $\psi(x) = e^{2\pi i x}$ of $\mathbb{R}$. Let $\alpha \in \tfrac{1}{2}\mathbb{Z} \setminus \mathbb{Z}$ be a half-integer that is not an integer, and define the character
$$\mu : \mathbb{C}^\times \to \mathbb{C}^\times, \qquad \mu(z) = (\bar z / z)^{\alpha}.$$
Associated to $(V_{p,q}, \psi, \mu)$ there is a Weil (oscillator) representation $\omega_{V_{p,q},\psi,\mu}$ of $U(V_{p,q})$ (the splitting of the metaplectic cover being determined by $\mu$).

Let $B \subset GL_n$ be the Borel subgroup of upper-triangular matrices. For $j = 1, \dots, n$, let $r_j \in \mathbb{C}$ and $k_j \in \mathbb{Z}$, and define the characters
$$\chi_j : \mathbb{C}^\times \to \mathbb{C}^\times, \qquad \chi_j(z) = |z|^{r_j} (z/\bar z)^{k_j/2}.$$
Assume that the (normalized) principal series representation
$$\Pi = \mathrm{Ind}_{B(\mathbb{C})}^{GL_n(\mathbb{C})}(\chi_1 \otimes \cdots \otimes \chi_n)$$
is irreducible and generic.

Prove that, among all signatures $(p,q)$ with $p+q = n$, the space of $U(V_{p,q})$-equivariant continuous linear maps
$$\mathrm{Hom}_{U(V_{p,q})}\bigl(\Pi,\ \omega_{V_{p,q},\psi,\mu}\bigr)$$
is nonzero if and only if
$$p = \#\{\, j : k_j > \alpha\,\} \qquad \text{and} \qquad q = \#\{\, j : k_j < \alpha\,\} = n - p.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The statement is a conjectural archimedean signature criterion for the twisted Gan–Gross–Prasad problem over $\mathbb{C}/\mathbb{R}$. Recent works establish the twisted GGP conjecture in certain tempered or low-rank/principal-series cases (e.g., a 2024–2025 J. Inst. Math. Jussieu paper on certain tempered L-packets, and other partial results), but I did not find a complete proof of this specific signature criterion for irreducible generic principal series of $GL_n(\mathbb{C})$ with a half-integral $\mu$. The conjecture appears to remain open in general.

status_evidence.title: Twisted Gan-Gross-Prasad conjecture for certain tempered L-packets
status_evidence.snippet: Affirmative evidence established for a family of tempered L-packets of unitary groups using theta correspondence.
status_evidence.claim: Only partial cases (certain tempered L-packets) are established.

status_evidence.title: Twisted GGP Problems and Conjectures (arXiv:2204.10108)
status_evidence.snippet: Formulates twisted GGP conjectures with evidence in low rank and for unitary principal series.
status_evidence.claim: The statement is presented as a conjecture with only partial evidence.
